headline: Weathered Expanse Steadies; Linn Mercy Toll Still Mounts
war_summary: Three hours after our last edition the picture is one of grind rather than breakthrough. The Weathered Expanse remains the liveliest field, with fifty flag events in the day and another exchange logged as this dispatch goes to press, yet its lines have not shifted: five Warden stands, one Colonial, three in rubble, Wightwalk, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance the busiest posts. The Nevish Line still tops the casualty ledger, some twenty-six thousand in a day, but its guns have slackened and no flag has moved there in two hours, the Colonial margin unchanged at six posts to two. Linn Mercy follows close behind with nearly twenty thousand casualties; the Colonials hold ten of its eleven stands, the eleventh demolished, Lathair and Outwich Ranch drawing the heaviest fire. Callahans Passage collects another heavy toll without a flag turning. Stonecradle has stirred anew, fourteen events at World's End and The Reach, while Mooring County's Wind Hills flare has fallen silent. It is day 757; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
